Our plumbing services

Services we offer: emergency repairs, leak detection and repair, water heater installation and repair, drain cleaning, bathroom and kitchen plumbing, and whole-house repiping.

We serve homeowners, landlords and small businesses in Riverton and the surrounding Alder Valley.

Emergency repairs

Burst pipe, overflowing toilet or no water at all? Our on-call plumber answers around the clock and can usually be with you within two hours anywhere in Riverton.

Leak detection and repair

We use acoustic and thermal tools to find hidden leaks behind walls and under floors, so we open up as little as possible.

Water heater installation and repair

We repair, replace and install gas, electric and tankless water heaters from all the major makers, and we haul the old unit away.

Drain cleaning

Slow sinks, gurgling showers and blocked main lines are cleared with augers and hydro-jetting, and we can camera-inspect the line to show you what caused it.

Bathroom and kitchen plumbing

New fixtures, valves, faucets and full remodel rough-ins, coordinated with your contractor or designer.

Whole-house repiping

Older Alder Valley homes often still have galvanized steel pipes. We replace them with PEX or copper, usually in two to four days.
